v0.0.1.description:
### Stray Archipelago v0.0.1

For instructions on how to set up and play this mod, check the [README](https://github.com/Nichologeam/StrayAP/blob/master/README.md).

# Known Issues
- Items received for chapters later than the one you are currently in are not added to the backpack until you reach that chapter. This is to prevent a crash, and I'll try to find a workaround at some point.
- This is generally untested, as my copy of Stray crashes when going past Slums Part 1.

v0.0.2.description:
### Stray Archipelago v0.0.2
All previous APWorlds are inherently not compatable due to how the mod's version checking system works.

For instructions on how to set up and play this mod, check the [README](https://github.com/Nichologeam/StrayAP/blob/master/README.md).

# Additions
- Added `apdisconnect` command
- The game now force-resyncs the cat's inventory on connect
# Fixes
- Fixed `apresync` deleting the cat's entire inventory
- Fixed disconnecting not working
- (probably) fixed Universal Tracker displaying the game always being in Go Mode [APWorld Change]
# Known Issues
- Items received for chapters later than the one you are currently in are not added to the backpack until you reach that chapter. This is to prevent a crash, and I'll try to find a workaround at some point.
- Universal Tracker throws "Cannot Create Item" errors.
- This is generally untested, as my copy of Stray crashes when going past Slums Part 1.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Nichologeam/StrayAP/compare/v0.0.1...v0.0.2

v0.0.3.description:
### Stray Archipelago v0.0.3
This update is compatible with worlds generated on all previous versions.

For instructions on how to set up and play this mod, check the [README](https://github.com/Nichologeam/StrayAP/blob/master/README.md).

# Additions:
- Added a lot more additional logging to hopefully catch cases of inventory corruption
# Changes:
- The version checking system now allows non-breaking version mismatches
# Fixes:
- Fixed Unreadable Sheet Music being logically unobtainable if Code Logic was enabled
- Fixed Universal Tracker being unable to process items correctly
- (maybe) fixed the game randomly disconnecting
# Known Issues:
- Items received for later chapters are not added to the backpack. This is to prevent a crash that I will try and find a workaround for later
- Receiving or resyncing the Outsider Notebooks while inside the Slums will cause B-12 to play its coresponding dialogue
- Receiving certain items at certain times can corrupt the inventory, causing a crash on the next checkpoint load. I'm looking into this

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Nichologeam/StrayAP/compare/v0.0.2...v0.0.3

v0.0.4.description:
### Stray Archipelago v0.0.4
This update is compatible with worlds generated on all previous versions.

For instructions on how to set up and play this mod, check the [README](https://github.com/Nichologeam/StrayAP/blob/master/README.md).

# Changes:
- Logic now accounts for needing to fix the tracker before giving it to Seamus to finish Slums Part 2
	- You now need the Poncho, Broken Tracker, and Fixed Tracker to logically finish the chapter
# Fixes:
- Fixed `Scratching Spot - Slums Meditation Room` not logically requiring the flat keys [APWorld Change]
- Fixed receiving items throwing an error sometimes
- Attempted to try fixing the inventory corruption issues
# Known Issues:
- Items received for later chapters are not added to the backpack. This is to prevent a crash that I will try and find a workaround for later
- Receiving or resyncing the Outsider Notebooks while inside the Slums will cause B-12 to play its corresponding dialogue
- Receiving certain items at certain times can corrupt the inventory, causing a crash on the next checkpoint load. I'm looking into this

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Nichologeam/StrayAP/compare/v0.0.3...v0.0.4
